item.title: ABC's of the Museum — Sun Sep 20, 1:00 PM — Bohart Museum of Entomology (Bohart Museum)
item.description:

There will be a craft, insects to hold and touch and scientists galore to meet and chat with. The event is free and open to the public, including parking in Lot 47 from 1-4 pm.
Source: The Dirt

item.title: Everything You Touch, Touches You: A Hands-On Collaborative Ceramic Installation — Sun Sep 20, 3:00 PM — International House (I-House)
item.description: Join ceramic artist Pinar Brummer for a hands-on, community-led gathering at International House Davis, in two parts. Together, we’ll shape a collaborative tree sculpture, then slow down to hand-build our own small ceramic pieces. No experience needed, just a willingness to show up, get elemental, and tap into some childlike joy. Pinar opens the gathering with her own story, her journey from Türkiye to Davis, and how it inspired this project, before inviting you to get your hands in the clay and be your childlike self. Part One: The Tree. Everything you touch, touches you is a reflection on togetherness, on how we’re not just observers but active participants in a shared experience, connected to each other and the world around us. At the heart of the gathering is an incomplete ceramic tree, hand-built by Pinar, waiting for your mark. You’ll shape a clay leaf to join it, no skill required, each one becoming part of a lasting, collective piece. Part Two: The Tea Cup. Pinar will guide

item.title: Midiposa Cafe — Mon Sep 21, 6:00 PM — 1550 Cannery Ave
item.description:

item.title: Intermediate Watercolor with Misuk Goltz — Tue Sep 22, 10:00 AM — Pence Gallery
item.description:
Intermediate Watercolor with Misuk Goltz Tuesdays, 10 AM – 12 PM | September 1, 8, 15, 22, 29 $170 Members, $190 Non-Members (Materials not included) This 5-week workshop with Misuk Goltz will focus on using your brushes to their full potential and practicing diverse hand motions to achieve painterly, expressive watercolor paintings. Students will learn how to distribute different values to create balanced and sophisticated artwork while painting various subjects. Please note that this class is intended for participants who have previous experience with watercolor techniques and color blending. The use of high-quality watercolor materials is strongly recommended to achieve the best results. Register here: https://pencegallery.org/education/programs/workshops-and-classes/ Any questions? Email pencegallery@gmail.com.

item.title: DJUSD Board Meetings — Thu Dec 3, 6:30 PM — City Hall Community Chambers
item.description:
DJUSD Board meetings offer insight on how the school district remains responsive to the community’s values, beliefs, and priorities. The Board meetings occur on every first and third Thursday, in the City of Davis Community Chambers. 23 Russell Boulevard. Public session starts at 6:30 PM. Meetings are cablecast live on Channel 17 (Comcast) or streamed on the DJUSD-TV website.
The Davis Joint Unified School District’s Board of Education is comprised of five community members, responsible for setting district policy, approving the budget, and hiring the superintendent for schools in Davis, California. The agendas for the meetings are posted at least 72 hours in advance.
For more information on special meetings, agendas, public comment, and more, visit the DJUSD Board site.
Source: Hate-Free Together

item.description: YoloSol presents Good Fire, Living Water: The Gifts of a Marsh Economy September 20-November 13, 2026 Weekdays: 9am-7pm Weekends: 9am-3pm @ Davis Arts Center “Tule has been my creative muse for 30 years. It still thrives in the rivers and marshes of California… Tule, along with cattail, is at the heart of the marsh economy… I am now in the process of working with ecologists and scientists to renew our understanding of how we can restore the wetlands. It is clear that cultural knowledge about tule is a critical part of the tools required in this endeavor.” – Diana Almendariz A public exhibition on wetland stewardship featuring the eco-cultural and artistic practice of Wintun/Maidu culture-bearer Diana Almendariz and her daughters Ooti Maxine and Christina Almendariz. The multimedia exhibit also highlights Diana’s collaboration with artists and scientists in the Yolo Bioregion. item.title: Davis Craft and Vintage Fair — Sun Sep 20, 10:00 AM — Central Park – Davis
item.description:
Davis Craft and Vintage Fair began as the Square Tomatoes Craft Fair more than 10 years ago! The event was started by instructors from the UC Davis Craft Center in order to have a monthly craft fair for local artisans and the local community. We embraced local vintage vendors in 2017, we’ve grown and we are still home to local artists and makers from the Davis and greater Sacramento area. We collaborate with local non-profits starting with Couleurs Vives Art Studio who joined us in 2018! Many of our talented vendors can be found at other festivals like the Davis Phoenix Coalition’s Pride Fest, the I-House’s International Festival, and 2nd Friday ArtAbouts on E Street Plaza. Expect to see friendly vendors with local handmade and original art, crafts, quality vintage items, upcycled treasures, earth-friendly creations, good food, and more. Free live music fills the open space for a lively atmosphere so be sure to stop by and join us!
Source: The Dirt

Start with decorative art papers and string to create your own flock of birds, and then add simple and fun touches using washi tape, feathers, and more. How it works: Art in Action engages kids in art projects that are fun, creative, and collaborative with their family members. This is a drop-in program for ages 5-12. No registration in advance is required, but space and supplies are limited to the first 25 participants and are available on a first come, first served basis. When you arrive, pay with cash or card at the front desk. A parent or adult caregiver is required to stay, but only has to pay for the project for themselves if they are also doing art. item.title: Grounded Together: Building Resilience, Connection, and Community — Wed Sep 23, 6:00 PM
item.description:
Iama Embodied Community ***P.S. this is part of a 5 week series, though not required, you are highly encouraged to attend all - No meeting on Oct 7***
